name: olist-analytics-dbt
description: ELT on Olist e-commerce data: dlt + dbt + DuckDB/BigQuery

paragraphs: End-to-end analytics engineering on the Olist Brazilian e-commerce dataset (100k orders, 2016–2018, 8 related tables), run as a data product: an owner, data contracts on its input and output, declared consumers, and CI that enforces all of it. dlt loads the data, dbt Core models it into a tested star schema and a semantic layer on DuckDB (local) and BigQuery (prod), Airflow + Cosmos replays it hourly as a live feed, and a Streamlit dashboard reads the result.
Built with AI pair programming (Claude Code); the architecture, design decisions and code review are mine. The reasoning behind each choice is in the decision log.
features: Data product with enforced contracts. Descriptor in the Open Data Product Standard (owner, input and output

ports), an ODCS data contract per port, 370 contract checks on the data in every CI run. The dashboard's usage agreement is checked against the SQL it actually sends, and a breaking contract change needs a new major…
One codebase, two warehouses. The same dbt models run on DuckDB and BigQuery with identical test results and
KPIs, through cross-database macros and per-adapter dispatch. → Data model
Team-grade CI/CD. Every PR: lint, type check, tests, a full build on DuckDB and slim CI on BigQuery
